notes: Approve Silent now uses Freecords' full silent approval, so songs get their ISRC and UPC and are delivered. Songs show whether a takedown is incomplete, in progress or confirmed. Overlord now sends Freecords one request at a time, loads only the newest 1,000 tickets, reads only new tickets at startup, and runs bulk ticket actions one at a time.

windows_notes: Overlord now sends Freecords one request at a time, so it can no longer overload it. Ticket lists load at most the newest 1,000 tickets (and say so) and refresh at most every 5 minutes, bulk actions in Tickets run one ticket at a time, and startup only reads new tickets. Approve Silent now does a full approval, so songs get their ISRC and UPC and are delivered. Songs now show whether a takedown is incomplete, in progress or confirmed.
